questions.text:
Quiet please!
Students are using this room to practise for the end-of-term concert.
Mr Jones
questions.passage: tức là không muốn nói chuyện ồn ào.
questions.expl: Mr Jones yêu cầu giữ trật tự ("Quiet please")
opts: Mr Jones would like students to practise quietly.
Mr Jones does not want people to talk loudly here.
Mr Jones wants to know which students were noisy.

questions.text:
Hi everyone,
I've lost my phone so don't try to call or text me!
However, I'll be near my computer most of the day.
Hannah

Why did Hannah write this message?
questions.expl: Hannah viết để báo bạn bè liên lạc với cô ấy qua máy tính vì bị mất điện thoại.
opts: to tell her friends how to contact her
to find out if anyone has seen her phone
to check if her friends are going out today

questions.text:
Highlands Park
Outdoor fitness equipment for over 12s only
Danger – don't use in rain
questions.expl: "Danger – don't use in rain" tương ứng với việc không nên tập luyện khi trời mưa / thời tiết ẩm ướt.
opts: You should not exercise here in wet weather.
It's not safe to use this equipment at the moment.
Children under 12 must be with an adult when using this equipment.

questions.text: Have you still got the boots I lent you? My brother wants them.
questions.expl: Tin nhắn hỏi xin lại đôi giày đã cho mượn ("My brother wants them").
opts: To ask for the boots back.

questions.text: We're closing on Saturday May 18th
questions.expl: Cửa hàng sẽ đóng cửa vào thứ Bảy ngày 18/5, tức là sau ngày 18/5 sẽ không thể mua sắm ở đây nữa.
opts: The shop is closed every Saturday.
You cannot shop here after May 18th.

questions.text: Do you think it'll be ready by then?
questions.expl: Hỏi xem liệu bức tranh có thể hoàn thành xong trước thời điểm đó hay không.
opts: checking if the art teacher is available
offering to help Harry with his painting
checking how soon Harry can finish his painting

questions.text: Who always visits museums when they travel?
questions.expl: Daniel nói: "I go to museums during my holidays in new cities."

questions.text: Who says it is important to visit the same museum several times?
questions.expl: Emily nói: "...return as often as you can to see the rest."

questions.text: Who likes museums where the exhibitions often change?
questions.expl: Chris nói: "I like museums where they move things round regularly, and bring in new things..."

questions.text: Who says that museums should have friendly staff?
questions.expl: Emily nói: "...the people who work in the museum are pleasant, and happy to talk to me..."

questions.text: Who says that they sometimes only look at a few things in a room?
questions.expl: Chris nói: "I just focus on one or two items in a room..."

questions.text: Who learns more in a museum than in a classroom?
questions.expl: Daniel nói: "I learn much more from seeing real things in a museum than from books in class."

questions.text: Who prefers going around a museum with a guide to going alone?
questions.expl: Emily nói: "I also think having a guide who can explain everything is much better..."

questions.text: Jay's first experience of hill running was with
questions.expl: Đoạn 1: "My dad took me and my brothers out running when we were little..."

questions.text: How does Jay feel about the good runners in his club?
questions.expl: Đoạn 2: "...I'm always a long way behind them. But that doesn't bother me."
opts: He'd like to be as fast as them one day.
He doesn't mind that they are better than him.
He thinks they should help slower runners improve.

questions.text: What does Jay say is important in the races he enters?
questions.expl: Đoạn 3: "You need a good map and compass so you don't get lost."
opts: being able to find your way

questions.text: What do we learn about the races from the fourth paragraph?
questions.expl: Đoạn 4: "There are no T-shirts or medals for the winners. The most you get is a piece of cake!"
opts: They are only for local runners.
They are free for some people to enter.

questions.text: What does Jay say about the last race he did?
questions.expl: Đoạn 5: "But I got to the end, and that was an amazing feeling."
opts: The bad weather made it dangerous.
He was very happy when he finished it.
It wasn't as difficult as some races he has done.

questions.expl: Cụm từ "at an early age" (từ khi còn nhỏ).
Cụm từ "successful career" (sự nghiệp thành công).
Cụm từ "won an important prize" (giành giải thưởng quan trọng).
Động từ phrasal "grew up" (trưởng thành
"returned to TV" (quay trở lại với màn ảnh truyền hình).
"called The Alienist" (được gọi/đặt tên là The Alienist).

sections.title: PART 5
sections.instr: For each question write the correct answer. Write one word for each gap.

questions.expl: Cụm từ "Thanks so much".
Cấu trúc gợi ý "Why don't you...?"
Chỉ thời gian "after school" (sau giờ học).
Cấu trúc "There are lots of things..."
Cụm từ "let you know" (cho bạn biết).
Động từ nguyên mẫu sau modal verb "will be".

questions.text:
You want to go clothes shopping on Saturday with your friend Ashley.
Write an email to Ashley.
In your email:
• ask Ashley to go shopping with you this Saturday
• explain why you need to buy new clothes
• suggest where to go shopping
Write 25 words or more.

sections.title: PART 7
sections.instr: Look at the three pictures and write the story.

questions.text:
Look at the three pictures.
Write the story shown in the pictures.
Write 35 words or more.
[có hình minh họa]
questions.expl: Bài viết mô tả diễn biến câu chuyện từ 3 bức tranh theo đáp án chuẩn.
questions.sample: Last Saturday, Jane and Susan went to an outdoor music concert. At first, they showed their tickets to the staff at the gate and walked inside. After that, they sat on the grass and had a nice picnic with delicious sandwiches and cold drinks. When the music started, they danced together in the crowd and had a wonderful time!
